60: From where do we [derive] - that a ḥalutza is permitted to marry? Perhaps it only that the Merciful One imposes the commandment to perform ḥalitza upon her, but that nevertheless she does not become permitted [to remarry].
In Israel: The house of him who had [his shoe] removed - the implication is as follows: she is fit to be brought to [another] house in Israel once she has performed ḥalitza.
